claude_proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitRecord lineage choice wrapper
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The unit is a single species trait whose first-class mechanic is choosing exactly one lineage branch at build time; the current species-trait record has no branch/variant shape.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose one of the following options; whichever one you choose...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Composite species-trait mechanics
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Forest Gnome combines always-on spell grants with limited free casting, while Rock Gnome combines granted cantrips with an activated clockwork-device ability; current species traits allow only passive or activation, not both.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You know the Minor Illusion cantrip. You also always have the Speak with Animals spell prepared. You can cast it without a spell slot a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: PB-scaled free-cast spell-access mode
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Existing spell-access modes cover prepared/known and once-per-long-rest grants, but not 'prepared plus free casts equal to Proficiency Bonus plus normal slot-casting'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can cast it without a spell slot a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. You can also use any spell slots you have to cast the spell.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Created reusable device with stored spell option and expiry
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Rock Gnome creates a temporary object that stores one chosen Prestidigitation effect, can be activated later by touch as a Bonus Action, is capped at three concurrent instances, and expires after 8 hours.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: spend 10 minutes casting Prestidigitation to create a Tiny clockwork device ... the device produces that effect whenever you or another creature takes a Bonus Action to activate it with a touch ... You can have three such devices in existence at a time, and each falls apart 8 hours after its creation
